heroText: Durban is South Africa's subtropical Indian Ocean city, famous for its warm surf beaches and the country's largest Indian community outside India. First-time visitors should walk the Golden Mile promenade, ride the SkyCar up Moses Mabhida Stadium's arch, and shop for spices and fabric at Victoria Street Market. King Shaka International Airport connects Durban nationally and regionally, and its beaches and bunny chow make it a laid-back contrast to South Africa's other big cities.

areas.name: Golden Mile / Beachfront
areas.text: The Golden Mile beachfront runs along Durban's main promenade, lined with hotels, surf schools and the uShaka Marine World aquarium.

areas.name: Umhlanga
areas.text: Umhlanga is an upscale beach suburb north of the centre, known for its lighthouse, malls and calmer stretches of sand.

areas.name: Berea
areas.text: Berea is a leafy hillside district above downtown, offering guesthouses and views back over the city and harbour.

areas.name: Morningside
areas.text: Morningside is a central residential area near restaurants and offices, convenient for business travelers wanting a quieter base.

airports.name: King Shaka International Airport (DUR)
airports.search: King Shaka International Airport, Durban, South Africa
airports.text: King Shaka International Airport sits around 35 kilometres north of the city near Umhlanga, connected by the Airport Shuttle bus and metered taxis.

airportTransfer.value: Compare road transfer time between King Shaka International Airport (DUR) and central Durban before choosing an airport-area or city-centre hotel.

stayOverview: Base along the Golden Mile for an easy first Durban stay near the beach, uShaka Marine World and Moses Mabhida Stadium, or choose Umhlanga for calmer beaches and shopping malls. Berea and Morningside suit travelers wanting quieter, hillside stays with easy access to the centre.
hotelIntro: Durban hotel choice depends on priorities: the Golden Mile suits first-time visitors wanting beach access and central sights, Umhlanga suits upscale beach stays near the airport, and Berea or Morningside suit business travelers and longer, quieter stays.
rentalCars: A rental car helps for day trips along the KwaZulu-Natal coast or into the Midlands, though the Golden Mile and Umhlanga are easily covered on foot or by taxi.

travelTips.title: Best base
travelTips.text: Choose the Golden Mile for beach access and central sights, or Umhlanga for a calmer beach base near the airport.

travelTips.title: Bunny chow
travelTips.text: Try bunny chow, Durban's signature curry-filled bread loaf, at one of the city's long-running Indian restaurants.

travelTips.title: Airport transfers
travelTips.text: Take the Airport Shuttle bus or a metered taxi from King Shaka International Airport for the roughly 40-minute ride into town.

travelTips.title: Beach safety
travelTips.text: Swim at lifeguard-patrolled beaches along the Golden Mile and check flag warnings, since currents can be strong.
